verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Workflows feature lets users automate processes to run in the background (hubspot-docs-12/45), and its Breeze AI agents explicitly operate autonomously — e.g., the prospecting agent 'watches accounts for signals... and reaches out automatically' and smart deal progression 'keeps deals moving after every call' (hubspot-docs-14/22/56). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of true unattended autonomy (one doc notes agents still require user approval of updates, hubspot-docs-23), and no detail on scheduling/trigger granularity or failure handling for long-running automations.
